candidate_write_boundaries.notes: Stable channels and integrations may be durable enterprise objects when they are registry-backed. Runtime batches, raw telemetry, and provenance-only links belong to the event/report layers.

notes: During the Hermes migration, only Jack, Jack X, and Memory Curator may commit reviewed shared-graph writes.
Specialist agents may emit graph candidates, but they do not mutate durable shared memory directly.
